text: Simulate pricing changes against historical usage before going live
quote: Test pricing changes against historical usage before deploying.

text: Automatically recalculates affected invoices when usage data arrives late
quote: Late data handled safely. Orb recalculates affected invoices automatically.

text: Ingests over 1M billing events per second in production
quote: Handle 1M+ billing events per second in production deployments.

text: Tracks accrued revenue pre-invoice to forecast and spot expansion opportunities
quote: Track accrued revenue before invoices. Forecast and spot expansion.

text: Lets you define complex billing metrics using full SQL control
quote: Build complex billing metrics with full SQL control.

text: Fires usage-threshold alerts to power product-led growth flows
quote: Trigger alerts at usage thresholds to power product-led growth.

text: Exports recognized/deferred revenue data to external financial systems
quote: Track recognized and deferred revenue with exports for financial systems.

text: Create subscriptions via the dashboard UI or a subscription creation API endpoint
quote: You can create a subscription either from the Orb UI or via the subscription creation API endpoint.

text: Align billing cycle anchors to the subscription's creation date
quote: Orb also allows you to align the billing cycles with the date that the subscription was created.

text: Edit a single subscription's pricing configuration without altering the underlying plan
quote: Subscription Edits let you change a single subscription's pricing configuration ... without changing the plan itself.

text: Preview billing/invoice impact of a change before saving it
quote: Preview the billing and invoice impact before you save, so you can confirm how charges and invoices will look.

text: Managed daily exports of resource data to a destination of your choice
quote: Orb supports managed, daily exports of resource types to your data destination of your choice.

text: Seamless migration from Stripe Billing for flat, usage, seat, or custom pricing
quote: Orb supports a seamless migration from Stripe Billing, whether you're using flat-rate subscriptions, usage-based pricing, pricing on seats, or you've implemented custom billing logic.

text: Backfill historical usage events to keep invoices and analytics accurate
quote: If you want Orb to generate accurate invoices or analytics based on prior usage data, you can backfill events.

text: Programmatic error responses include a type URI and status code for automated handling
quote: If you are processing an error programmatically, consider using the type URI along with the status code.

text: Day-based proration credits customers for unused time in a billing period
quote: Orb will credit the customer an amount corresponding to the portion of the time period that was left unused using day-based proration.

text: Per-event idempotency guarantees duplicate usage events aren't double-processed
quote: Orb provides per-event idempotency through the API to guarantee that duplicates are never processed within the account grace period.

text: Billable metrics are built from event filters plus an aggregation clause
quote: A billable metric consists of event filters as well as an aggregation clause.

text: Automatically retries failed charges on a fixed 1/4/9-day cadence
quote: Orb will automatically retry the charge after 1, 4, and 9 days from the initial payment attempt.

text: Supports minimum charge floors and maximum charge caps on pricing
quote: Minimums: Ensures a minimum charge is applied. Maximums: Caps the charge at a certain amount.

text: Choose automatic invoice issuance after grace periods or require manual approval
quote: Automatic Issuance ... Invoices auto-issue after grace periods and buffers ... Manual Issuance ... All invoices require manual approval before issuance

text: Automatically calculates recognized revenue per ASC 606 guidelines
quote: Orb automatically calculates recognized revenue in a way that accords with ASC606 guidelines.

text: Real-time webhooks system delivers calls to your endpoint on platform events
quote: Orb provides a powerful, real-time webhooks system that can issue calls to an endpoint of your choosing when certain events take place.
